title: Make the C4b Database source inventory clean-commit reproducible
goal: Remove ignored dependency and cache bytes from the Database evidence lock while preserving fail-closed source drift detection and identical Windows/Linux semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: A hash-bound source-inventory authority freezes roots, extensions, generated-directory exclusions, ordinal ordering and UTF-8/LF-normalized hashing; producer v2 fails unless its selected filesystem set equals the Git tracked set.

The adapter requires the v2 producer and exact contract, compares the complete locked path/hash inventory, and rejects selected additions, deletions, content drift, malformed inventory and old locks without executing Git.
C4b clean/violation/missing/zero/stale/tamper tests pass; ignored node_modules/cache injection is irrelevant while an untracked selected file outside exclusions fails closed.
Clean Windows and pinned offline Linux produce identical source path/hash inventories without transporting node_modules, and the updated C6 runner verifies the same contract.
Published 1.1.3 Package identity, synthetic Host Post, immutable roots, isolated IFX Package regression, Formal Pre and exact committed Formal Diff pass; C6c/C6d/C6e remain unclaimed.
